# Symplectic_Neural_Networks

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
Neural network architectures that preserve symplectic structure in phase space, modeling Hamiltonian dynamics for energy-conserving systems. Enables energy-efficient and physically consistent modeling of neuromorphic dynamics, crucial for stable and predictable in-network computation.
